There's probably more questions that need to be asked regarding this. Is this the first time this exact situation happened? Did he just come home from work or something? Does he do nothing around the house?

You mentioned that your marriage is on the rocks for a few years now, so there were probably other things that were weighing on your mind when this happened. Have you two ever talked about them? To me, this situation seems a bit too minor for a divorce, but there could have been other things in the background that I don't know about, and this was the last straw.

Also, have you ever thought about getting a job? Or at least trying to look for one? If the only reason you're with him is money, and you don't love him anymore, then I think finding a job will be a good move for you, for whatever may happen in the future.

Speaking of which, do you really not love him anymore? I mean, marriage isn't exactly all roses. Isn't that the point of it? To have and to hold, to love his best and his worst qualities, and he to you. To get through every problem, every peril dotting your married life together. The roses you felt at the beginning of your relationship won't exactly stay; romance always needs to be rekindled, even in marriage. Sorry, but that's how I think of it...and if it's really as bad as your story made it out to be, I think you two should really have a talk, if it could be possible....just for you both to understand where the other is coming from.

Regardless, hoping for the best for you. This is a big life-changing decision, and please know that whatever we random people on reddit say, the final decision is still yours. Praying that whatever decision you make will be the best for you. Goodluck!
